cases.description: Ensures that a null schemaPath does not cause a NullPointerException and is correctly propagated to the ValidationContext.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema child schema is returned. ValidationContext receives a null JsonNode. No exception is thrown.

cases.description: Validates that the method can handle both parameters being null simultaneously.

group: ValidationContext returns same instance as parent

cases.expected: The JsonSchema instance returned by createChildSchema is exactly the same object as the parent schema (as supplied by the mocked ValidationContext). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Ensures that createChildSchema returns whatever ValidationContext.newSchema returns, even if it is the parent instance itself, confirming no additional wrapping or cloning occurs.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown because getValidationContext() returns null and the method attempts to invoke newSchema on a null reference.
cases.description: Simulates a mis‑configured JsonSchema where the underlying ValidationContext is null. The method should not swallow the NPE; it must propagate it.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or a subclass) thrown by ValidationContext.newSchema when it attempts to treat the malformed schemaPath as a URI. The exception propagates out of createChildSchema.
cases.description: Provides a schemaPath that is not a valid URI. The mocked ValidationContext is configured to throw an IllegalArgumentException wrapping a URISyntaxException, verifying that createChildSchema does not catch or transform the exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown by ValidationContext.newSchema because the supplied schemaNode contains an unsupported "type" value. The same exception propagates unchanged.
cases.description: Mocks ValidationContext.newSchema to throw IllegalArgumentException for an unsupported schema type, ensuring the method does not swallow the exception.

group: ValidationContext throws IllegalStateException for malformed schemaNode

cases.expected: IllegalStateException thrown by ValidationContext.newSchema because the schemaNode lacks a required "type" field for a property definition. The exception propagates out of createChildSchema.
cases.description: Simulates a scenario where the schemaNode is syntactically valid JSON but semantically incomplete, causing ValidationContext to raise an IllegalStateException. The test confirms that createChildSchema does not intercept this exception.
